name: Dockerfile Generator
summary: Generate starter Dockerfiles for Node, Next.js, Python, Go, and static nginx — tweak port, tags, and users.
description: Pick a stack template and customize runtime tags, ports, workdirs, start commands, non-root users, and multi-stage builds. Copy a ready-to-edit Dockerfile. Everything runs locally.

faqs.question: Are these production-ready images?
faqs.answer: They are curated starters for common stacks. Review security, caching layers, and your app’s start path before shipping.

faqs.question: Does Next.js need special config?
faqs.answer: The Next.js template expects next.config output: 'standalone' so the runner stage can copy .next/standalone.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation runs entirely in your browser.
